name: Bello Abdulrafiu
title: Software QA Engineer | Manual and Automation Testing
summary: ISTQB Certified Tester with experience in web, mobile, and API testing across EdTech, healthcare, and financial technology. Leads QA for Miva University Exam Portal, combining exploratory and risk-based testing with Playwright automation, CI/CD integration, and release validation. Uses AI agents in spec-driven test workflows and conducts k6 load testing at up to 35,000 virtual users.

experience.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
bullets: Lead manual, exploratory, regression, and risk-based testing for Miva University Exam Portal; coordinate coverage with Engineering and Product, mentor QA engineers, and support release and hotfix validation.
Validate authentication, exam eligibility, enrollment mapping, results, and data consistency across Exam Portal, SIS, SSO, Learner Backend, and Tutor Admin.
Investigate exam-access, permission, audio-capture, and concurrent-session defects using DevTools, Postman, SQL, logs, and monitoring; document reproducible evidence in Jira.
Test exam integrity through identity/QR verification, Safe Exam Browser (SEB) configuration, camera/audio permissions, and screen/focus monitoring.
Build Playwright UI/API tests in TypeScript and JavaScript using reusable page objects, fixtures, authentication helpers, parallel execution, and CI/CD.
Use AI agents to generate, execute, refine, and integrate tests into CI from specifications and test plans; write Maestro Android tests with WireMock backend mocks.
Execute staged k6 load tests reaching 35,000 virtual users; investigate HTTP errors, timeouts, backend instability, infrastructure constraints, and load-generator limits.

experience.title: Software QA Engineer (SDET)
bullets: Developed Appium/TestNG mobile test suites with LambdaTest and integrated them into GitHub Actions; expanded the existing Cypress web test suite.
Performed manual testing against functional and non-functional requirements, collaborating with developers to document and resolve defects.
Reduced regression testing time by 30% through automated testing integrated into CI/CD.

experience.title: QA Engineer
bullets: Performed manual testing of the web and mobile apps for Risevest, a digital investment platform offering dollar-denominated portfolios across stocks, real estate, and fixed income.
Developed mobile test automation using WebDriver, WebdriverIO, and Detox.

experience.title: Software QA Engineer
bullets: Executed and refined manual test cases for healthcare applications; investigated defects with developers and maintained test plans, cases, and documentation in Agile teams.
Built and maintained Python/Pytest/unittest and Cypress automation suites with Allure reporting and GitHub Actions integration.
Performed API testing with Postman and automated API checks in JavaScript; used Jira and Xray for test management and defect tracking.

experience.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
bullets: Performed manual and automated testing for healthcare software, including Lomis Deliver web and mobile applications; defined testing requirements with developers and project managers.
Built test automation with Jest, Chai, Selenium, and Docker, integrating suites into Travis CI.
Tracked defects through resolution and maintained test plans, test cases, and reports.

experience.title: Software QA Intern
bullets: Executed manual tests, reported defects, and supported automation using JavaScript, Java, and Python; tested APIs with Postman.
